# xshield_paths (Data Source)

Traffic paths observed between assets and their peers.

Use this to see which peers actually talk to an asset before deciding which template paths to write. As with ports, `reviewed` is the intent and `enforced` is what the firewall runs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Who actually connects to the payroll database, before writing template paths.
data "xshield_paths" "into_payroll_db" {
  criteria = "application = 'payroll' AND role = 'db'"
}

output "peers" {
  value = toset([
    for p in data.xshield_paths.into_payroll_db.paths : p.source_asset_name
    if p.direction == "inbound" && p.source_asset_name != null
  ])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `criteria` (String) Criteria selecting the paths, written against the path scope.

### Optional

- `destination_criteria` (String) Additional criteria narrowing the destination side of the path.
- `max_results` (Number) Stop after this many results. Left unset, every match is read. When a limit truncates the result set, `truncated` is true.
- `source_criteria` (String) Additional criteria narrowing the source side of the path.

### Read-Only

- `paths` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--paths))
- `total` (Number) Total number of paths matching the criteria, as reported by the API.
- `truncated` (Boolean) True when `max_results` stopped the read before the end of the result set.

<a id="nestedatt--paths"></a>
### Nested Schema for `paths`

Read-Only:

- `connection_count` (Number) Connections observed over the reporting window.
- `destination_asset_id` (String)
- `destination_asset_name` (String)
- `destination_named_network` (String) Named network the destination falls in.
- `direction` (String) Inbound or outbound, relative to the asset.
- `domain` (String)
- `dst_ip` (List of String)
- `enforced` (String) What the firewall is enforcing for this path today.
- `id` (String) Channel hash identifying the path.
- `internet_facing` (Boolean)
- `matched_by_templates` (List of String)
- `port` (String)
- `protocol` (String)
- `reviewed` (String) The decision recorded for this path.
- `source_asset_id` (String)
- `source_asset_name` (String)
- `source_named_network` (String) Named network the source falls in, when it is not a managed asset.
- `src_ip` (String)
